newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Central Bank of Korea seen selling dlrs at 881.50.
newsitem.headline: Central Bank of Korea seen selling dlrs at 881.50.

text.p: The central Bank of Korea stepped into late afternoon interbank trading on Monday to sell dollars at the 881.50 won level, dealers said.
The central bank has refused to confirm or deny that it intervenes in the market.
The won rose to 880.00 just after the intervention.
Dealers said the dollar's bullish trend would be difficult to stem due to a steady inflow of import settlements and the nation's widening currenct account deficit.
The U.S. unit's strong trend against the Japanese yen on world markets also pressured the won.
